data.title: Grundpreis increase for tariff "Web & TV 250"
data.summary: Beispiel Kabel & Web GmbH informs Tarek Beispiel that the monthly base price of the "Web & TV 250" tariff will rise from €34.99 to €37.99 as of 1 June 2027, citing higher licensing and network costs. The letter also points out a special right to terminate the contract early under § 57 Abs. 1 TKG.
data.explanation: Your cable/internet provider is raising your monthly base fee from €34.99 to €37.99 starting 1 June 2027. Because this is a price increase to your disadvantage, German law (§ 57 Abs. 1 TKG) gives you a special right to cancel the contract early, without cost and without the usual notice period, within a window after you received this letter — the app will show you until when this window runs. If you do nothing, the new, higher price simply applies from the effective date. You may want to compare offers before deciding whether to cancel or stay.
